FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsq.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' 
  AND hsq.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'

    CASE 
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsq.datetime) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'rush'
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsq.datetime) BETWEEN 10 AND 14 THEN 'offpeak'
    END as period,
    AVG(hsq.no2) as avg_no2,
    AVG(hsq.pm2_5) as avg_pm25

    (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsq.datetime) BETWEEN 7 AND 8)

    (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsq.datetime) BETWEEN 10 AND 14)
  )
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period
""")

# Recompute off-peak ratio using the same method as original (direct average of all readings)
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get all roadside data for Oct 2025
query = text("""
SELECT hsaq.datetime, hsaq.no2, hsaq.pm2_5
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE aqs.station_type = 'ROADSIDE'
  AND hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL
  AND hsaq.pm2_5 IS NOT NULL
  AND hsaq.pm2_5 > 0
""")
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['datetime']).dt.hour

# Rush: 08:00-09:00 (hour 8), 17:00-19:00 (hours 17, 18)
# Off-peak: 00:00-05:00 (hours 0-4), 10:00-15:00 (hours 10-14)
rush_mask = df['hour'].isin([8, 17, 18])
offpeak_mask = df['hour'].isin([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14])

# Method 1: ratio of averages (mean NO2 / mean PM2.5)
rush_ratio_1 = df.loc[rush_mask, 'no2'].mean() / df.loc[rush_mask, 'pm2_5'].mean()
offpeak_ratio_1 = df.loc[offpeak_mask, 'no2'].mean() / df.loc[offpeak_mask, 'pm2_5'].mean()

print(f"Method 1 (ratio of averages):")
print(f"  Rush: {rush_ratio_1:.4f} -> {round(rush_ratio_1, 2)}")
print(f"  Off-peak: {offpeak_ratio_1:.4f} -> {round(offpeak_ratio_1, 2)}")

# Method 2: average of per-hour ratios (mean of no2/pm2.5 per row)
rush_ratio_2 = df.loc[rush_mask, 'no2'].div(df.loc[rush_mask, 'pm2_5']).mean()
offpeak_ratio_2 = df.loc[offpeak_mask, 'no2'].div(df.loc[offpeak_mask, 'pm2_5']).mean()

print(f"\nMethod 2 (mean of per-hour ratios):")
print(f"  Rush: {rush_ratio_2:.4f} -> {round(rush_ratio_2, 2)}")
print(f"  Off-peak: {offpeak_ratio_2:.4f} -> {round(offpeak_ratio_2, 2)}")

# The SQL verification used a different approach (avg of hourly avgs), which is a 3rd method
# Let's check what the SQL actually computed
hourly_avgs = df.groupby('hour').agg({'no2': 'mean', 'pm2_5': 'mean'}).reset_index()
rush_hours = hourly_avgs[hourly_avgs['hour'].isin([8, 17, 18])]
offpeak_hours = hourly_avgs[hourly_avgs['hour'].isin([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14])]

rush_ratio_3 = rush_hours['no2'].mean() / rush_hours['pm2_5'].mean()
offpeak_ratio_3 = offpeak_hours['no2'].mean() / offpeak_hours['pm2_5'].mean()

print(f"\nMethod 3 (avg of hourly avgs then ratio):")
print(f"  Rush: {rush_ratio_3:.4f} -> {round(rush_ratio_3, 2)}")
print(f"  Off-peak: {offpeak_ratio_3:.4f} -> {round(offpeak_ratio_3, 2)}")
